52: {
53:     if (ABS(friction) > ABS(fp->gr_vel)) {
54:         friction = -fp->gr_vel;
55:     } else if (fp->gr_vel > 0) {
56:         friction = -friction;
57:     }
58:     fp->xE4_ground_accel_1 = friction;
59: }
